Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The provider must ensure that content is regularly reviewed and updated to reflect developments in technology and industry practices.
